name: logos-vscode
description: A local VS Code workbench with the LOGOS agent core included.

logos.autoStart.description: Start LOGOS automatically when the chat view opens.

logos.observability.enabled.description: Send LOGOS Pi traces through the locally installed LoongSuite Pilot. Pilot controls the destination and content capture. Restart LOGOS after changing this setting.

logos.observability.pilotDataDirectory.description: Absolute LoongSuite Pilot data directory. Empty uses .loongsuite-pilot in your home directory. Restart LOGOS after changing this setting.

logos.update.feedUrl.description: GitHub API base URL used to check for LOGOS extension updates. It must serve GitHub-shaped releases JSON; point it at an internal mirror to bypass GitHub.

logos.update.autoCheck.description: Silently check for LOGOS extension updates on startup (at most once every 24 hours).

logos.nodeExecutable.description: Absolute path to a Node.js executable (22.19.0 or newer). Set it when the host's Node.js (for example one installed via nvm) is not on the extension host PATH. Leave empty to prefer a qualifying Node.js on PATH and fall back to the bundled runtime. Restart LOGOS after changing this setting.

scripts.compile: npm run clean && npm run typecheck && npm run build:extension && npm run build:webview
scripts.package:win32-x64: npm run prepare:runtime -- --target win32-x64 && npm run compile && npm run verify:runtime -- --target win32-x64 && npm run smoke:runtime -- --target win32-x64 && vsce package --target win32-x64
scripts.package:linux-x64: npm run prepare:runtime -- --target linux-x64 && npm run compile && npm run verify:runtime -- --target linux-x64 && npm run smoke:runtime -- --target linux-x64 && vsce package --target linux-x64
scripts.package:linux-arm64: npm run prepare:runtime -- --target linux-arm64 && npm run compile && npm run verify:runtime -- --target linux-arm64 && npm run smoke:runtime -- --target linux-arm64 && vsce package --target linux-arm64
